deals.title: All-Inclusive Day Use at Rixos Premium Saadiyat
deals.price_text: AED 695 per adult · kids 2–6 half price · under 2 free
deals.details: Pool and beach access with breakfast (09:00–11:00), lunch (12:30–15:30) and an all-inclusive drinks package. Not valid on holidays and blackout dates; booking required.
